iwantquests.configuration.title: IWantQuests Settings
iwantquests.configuration.backgroundOpac: Percentage of the theme's background opacity to apply (0-100).
iwantquests.configuration.blur.tooltip: Blur the world behind the quest book. The theme must also allow blur.
iwantquests.configuration.theme.tooltip: Theme ID such as iwantquests:midnight. Empty uses the chapter's theme.
iwantquests.ui.title: IWantQuests
iwantquests.ui.no_chapters: No chapters yet. Add quest JSON in config/iwantquests/quests.
iwantquests.ui.team.explain: Your solo progress is copied into the new team. Invite friends once it's created.
iwantquests.ui.team.confirm_leave: Leave %s? Your solo progress will be restored.
iwantquests.configuration.editorNamespac: Namespace for chapters created in the quest editor, such as mypack.
iwantquests.ui.editor.edit_tip: Author a private quest draft. Review and publish when ready.
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.select: Select and move quests. Drag a quest to move it, Shift-click or Shift-drag to select several. Key: V
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.link: Click a quest, then the quest that requires it. Click the same pair again to unlink. Key: L
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.add: Click the canvas to add a quest. Shift-click adds one that requires the selected quest. Right-click also adds. Key: A
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.delete: Delete the selected quests. Undo brings them back. Key: Delete
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.snap: Snap quests to an 8 unit grid while moving. Hold Alt to move freely for one drag. Key: G
iwantquests.ui.editor.no_chapters: No chapters yet. Use New chapter in the panel on the right.
iwantquests.ui.editor.readonly: Read-only. This quest comes from bundled content or a data pack. Only quests in config/iwantquests/quests can be edited.
iwantquests.ui.editor.readonly_chapter: Read-only. This chapter comes from bundled content or a data pack. You can still add quests to it.
iwantquests.ui.editor.readonly_quest: %s is read-only. Only quests in config/iwantquests/quests can be edited.
iwantquests.ui.editor.field.title: Title
iwantquests.ui.editor.field.subtitle: Subtitle
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.held: Use the item in your main hand
iwantquests.ui.editor.optional_tip: Optional quests do not count towards chapter progress
iwantquests.ui.editor.hidden_tip: Hidden quests stay invisible until they unlock
iwantquests.ui.editor.repeatable_tip: Starts over once every teammate has claimed. Craft, kill and submit tasks only
iwantquests.ui.editor.retroactive_tip: Collect progress while locked; complete once unlocked
iwantquests.ui.editor.prerequisites_none: Nothing. Use the Link tool to add one.
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.task_type: Change what this task asks for
iwantquests.ui.editor.last_task: A quest needs at least one task.
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.set_here: Use a box around your position in your current dimension
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.add_command: Add a command reward (server owners only)
iwantquests.ui.editor.reward_options_jso: %s options. Edit these in the quest file.
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.align_x: Move the selected quests onto the first one's column
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.align_y: Move the selected quests onto the first one's row
iwantquests.ui.editor.hold_item: Hold an item in your hand first.
iwantquests.ui.editor.confirm_delete_cha: Delete %s and its %s quests? Undo (Ctrl+Z) in the editor brings them back.
iwantquests.ui.editor.tip.save: Save unfinished fields and movement to your private draft (Ctrl+S). Publish from Review to update players.
iwantquests.ui.editor.hint.select: Drag to move. Shift-click to select more.
iwantquests.ui.editor.hint.link_end: Choose the quest that requires it. Esc cancels.
iwantquests.ui.editor.hint.add: Click the canvas to create a quest.
iwantquests.ui.chooser.search: Search by name, ID or mod…
iwantquests.ui.picker.title: Choose an item or tag
iwantquests.ui.picker.open: Browse items and preview matching tags
iwantquests.ui.templates.title: Quest templates
iwantquests.ui.templates.tip.save: Save the selected quests as a reusable template
iwantquests.ui.templates.count: %s quests · place in the current chapter
iwantquests.ui.editor.copied: Copied %s quests. Ctrl+V pastes in the current chapter.
iwantquests.ui.draft.title: Review draft changes
iwantquests.ui.draft.preview_notice: Draft preview · fresh player · actions disabled
iwantquests.ui.draft.conflict: Published quests changed. This draft cannot publish.
iwantquests.ui.draft.private: Private draft · players use published quests
iwantquests.ui.draft.discard_detail: Delete all unpublished changes and start from the current published book? Published quests and player progress remain unchanged.
iwantquests.ui.draft.confirm: Publish %s added, %s changed and %s removed quests? There are %s progress/reward warnings. This updates the book for everyone.
iwantquests.ui.search.title: Find a quest
iwantquests.ui.pins.limit: You can pin up to three quests. Unpin one first.
iwantquests.ui.pins.save_failed: Could not save pinned quests. Check the client config folder.
iwantquests.ui.editor.selection_large: This selection is too large to send. Copy a smaller group.
